epic.title: Session Time Travel
epic.blurb: Verified bounded Linux/GPU time travel: saved recordings, exact seeks and steps, private branches and local recording files. Full Omarchy cold qualification and performance budgets remain deferred and unproven.

caps.evidence: E9-T03: bounded IndexedDB chunks, atomic commit cursors, reload/crash and two-tab writer proofs

caps.name: Immutable historical disk roots
caps.evidence: E9-T04: private COW restores, exact base/generation bindings and shared-block retention

caps.name: Coherent software machine checkpoints
caps.evidence: E9-T05: exact native/input/disk tuple, atomic publication and private reload restore

caps.name: Large local session metadata
